name: output_public_url
title: Create public MP4 review and download links
description: Creates expiring public review and direct-download URLs for one exact finished BitterClip render. The review URL is the practical human handoff; download_url remains the primitive for external services that ingest a public video URL (captioning/styling connectors like Submagic, Zapier steps, publishing tools). It takes exactly ONE target: episode_id for an Episode/derived-clip handle, OR render_id for a ready render artifact alone; never both. A derived clip's comp_... handle goes in episode_id. This tool never starts or retries rendering: render_not_ready means render_status has not yet reported the render_create lifecycle ready. Repeating the call for the same ready render is safe and does not enqueue or mutate a render; it only returns fresh expiring bearer URLs. A later render invalidates these links rather than silently showing a different cut. A UI-supplied expected_render_generation makes a stale card fail instead of sharing a newer Render. title and dictionary give a receiving service context for download_url.

episode_id.description: Single target for an Episode or derived-clip composition ID such as comp_...; recording handles src_... resolve to their episode-of-one. Not combined with render_id.

render_id.description: Single target for a ready rart_... render artifact from render_status. Not combined with episode_id.

expires_in_days.description: Link lifetime in days. Default 7; minimum 1, maximum 14.

expected_render_generation.description: Optional opaque optimistic precondition from an Outputs result. If that exact rendered generation changed, this call fails instead of sharing a newer cut.

examples.label: Handoff a ready Episode or derived clip
Handoff when only the ready render artifact is in context

review_url.description: Public, expiring review page for this exact Render.

title.description: Episode/clip title, for the receiving service.

render_generation.description: Opaque identity for the exact rendered bytes and poster bound to these URLs.

dictionary.description: Account, project, speaker, and brand names a captioning service should preserve.
